feature: Clean native iPhone portrait and Duo README previews

scenarios.name: A concise synthetic conversation is readable in portrait and Duo previews
scenarios.given: the isolated simulator preview has two finalized synthetic transcript lines and an authored Quick answer at standard text size on an iPhone 17 Pro or Pro Max
scenarios.when: its iPhone workspace is opened in portrait, its Quick panel is scrolled normally if needed to expose the complete answer, and it is then rotated into landscape for README screenshots, including the shorter non-Max viewport
scenarios.then: both real layouts show the two complete authored lines and the complete Quick answer in their separate viewports; Duo retains idle Start and Notes controls at least 44 points high and no debug, recovery or alert overlay; this does not require all scrollable status controls or long conversations to fit
